note: Collected 2026-09-29 for src/content/articles/hotels-with-pool-london.md. SERP-first: Bing HTML for 'hotels with pool London' (first query only - Bing then degraded to one-word matching), then Yahoo (Bing-backed, via curl) for 22 reader queries: the lead phrases, rooftop, outdoor, family/kids, cheap/affordable, spa, Reddit, Mumsnet, YouTube. Brave returned 429 and DuckDuckGo html/lite returned a 202 bot challenge throughout, so neither contributed. Booking engines (Booking.com, Tripadvisor, Hotels.com, lastminute, Expedia, Hotwire, HotelsCombined, LateRooms) and brand pages (Marriott, IHG) filled much of every SERP and are refused by the hotel-corpus rule. Every source below is one domain; build-evidence counts domains, so Time Out's two lists and DesignMyNight's two lists count once each.

City-template databases or booking engines; the <city>_<area> URL is the tell. eurovistatrips.com surfaced twice and is already excluded.
Both returned a Cloudflare challenge (403) to curl; not read, not recorded. Worth a browser read on the next pass.
